verdict.rationale: Google Workspace is a cloud directory and identity product, so serving legacy protocols like LDAP and RADIUS is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents only SAML-based SSO, provisioning, 2SV and Context-Aware Access. Nothing in it mentions a cloud LDAP endpoint, a RADIUS service, or VPN/Wi-Fi authentication, so there is no support for this story.

support.subject: As an IT admin, legacy protocols still work — cloud LDAP and RADIUS endpoints serve the VPNs, Wi-Fi, and older systems that will never speak SAML
